item.title: Version 1.1.7
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.7

  • Buy Target Parsing & Saving: Fixed an issue where prices with thousand separators could not be saved. Added robust locale-aware number parsing across sheets and forms.
  • Popover Key Status & Responsiveness: Converted the buy target dialog to an in-popover overlay and automatically dismiss open popovers on app switch to prevent window unresponsiveness.
  • Full Localization: Added complete translations for Buy Target forms, context menus, and notifications across 8 supported languages.
